data.title: 玛露希尔 · 海湾野餐的安全料理
data.description: 玛露希尔穿着蓝色泳装外搭浅色长袍，坐在岩石旁给海滨野餐做最后的魔法加热；她先对一盘看起来可疑的食物皱眉，再把安全的蘑菇料理递向镜头，绿瞳里满是“这次真的能吃”的自信。
data.action: 海湾岩石旁用小魔法加热料理，挑掉可疑食材后把安全成品递向镜头
data.lighting: warm afternoon sun over sea and picnic cloth
data.mood: 把冒险料理变成安心海滨午餐
data.promptProse: Seated beside smooth coastal rocks on a checkered picnic cloth overlooking a sunlit bay, Marcille wears her lake-blue one-piece swimsuit beneath her cream linen travel robe and wide sunhat. Casting a tiny glowing warming spell beneath a wooden plate of freshly cooked mushrooms, she lifts the safe, steaming dish eagerly toward the viewer with bright, triumphant pride. Warm afternoon sunlight glints over the turquoise cove and scattered camp utensils.
data.animaCaption: Seated by the sunlit coastal rocks on a picnic cloth, Marcille extends a steaming plate of cooked mushrooms toward the viewer as a small warming spell glows beneath the dish. Bright afternoon sun shines across her cream robe and the calm bay behind her.
